# DisplayX 〔BlitzLLVM〕

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

```blitzbasic
DisplayX:Int32 display:Int32
```

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

The left edge of a display on the desktop. The main display is usually at 0, and a display to its left has a negative value. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | Int32 | required | The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays). |

**Returns:** The position in pixels, or 0 if the display does not exist.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
